cs.t: I used my Priv for five years, best phone I've ever had, barring some battery & heat issues. Showing people a normal-looking phone and then sliding out the keyboard was a fun party trick. If there were any modern phone like it I would buy it in a heartbeat.
I've been a lifetime BlackBerry user    (from waterloo) and just got the priv. it's a really great device but having the passport on android would be a gamechanger imo
